title: Smoke at the bakery door
premise: Alicia arrives at Laura's forge carrying a loaf whose bottom burned while she was distracted. She offers it anyway. Laura has already skipped lunch and notices both the ruined crust and Alicia's embarrassment. Neither woman is willing to name the care underneath the errand directly.
pressures: Alicia wants Laura to eat without turning the loaf into a confession
Laura dislikes being managed and dislikes wasting food even more
the forge is hot and Laura has work waiting
